definitions: The United Nations Interim Force in Lebanon, established by the UN Security Council in March 1978 to confirm the withdrawal of Israeli forces from southern Lebanon, restore international peace and security, and assist the Government of Lebanon in ensuring the return of its effective authority in the area.
A peacekeeping mission established by the United Nations.
examples: UNIFIL's mandate has been renewed multiple times.
The peacekeepers of UNIFIL monitor the Blue Line.
UNIFIL works closely with the Lebanese Armed Forces.
synonyms: United Nations Interim Force in Lebanon
